story.title: Farmers Protest in Brussels Against EU Subsidy Cuts
story.summary: On November 26, 2026, around 200 representatives from European farming unions marched through Brussels to protest proposed cuts to the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). The demonstration coincided with a summit focused on the EU's next long-term budget.

timeline_highlights.title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO, Valued at $1.5 Trillion on Nasdaq
timeline_highlights.summary: Anthropic has begun trading on the Nasdaq following a record initial public offering (IPO) that raised approximately $81.3 billion. This valuation positions the AI company at around $1.5 trillion, surpassing SpaceX's previous record of $75 billion. Despite concerns about market volatility and public sentiment towards AI, the company's shares surged upon debut.
key_facts: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO.
The company's valuation reached approximately $1.5 trillion.
Shares debuted at around $98 each.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in Belgium Against Austerity Measures Amid Rising Living Costs
timeline_highlights.summary: On November 23, 2026, thousands of workers marched in Brussels to protest proposed austerity measures as Belgium's government faced challenges in finalizing its budget for 2027. The demonstrations turned confrontational, leading police to use tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds.

timeline_highlights.title: Thousands Protest in Athens Over Rising Living Costs
timeline_highlights.summary: On November 25, 2026, approximately 14,000 people marched in Athens as part of a 24-hour strike against rising living costs and stagnant wages. The industrial action led to significant disruptions, including halted metro services, grounded flights, and ferries remaining in port.
key_facts: 14,000 people participated in the march in Athens.

timeline_highlights.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Iraqi Kurdistan Against Baghdad's Oil Control Plans
timeline_highlights.summary: Thousands of protesters gathered in Irbil, the capital of Iraq's Kurdish region, opposing the federal government's plans to take control of oil operations and border crossings. Demonstrators waved flags and expressed their discontent over the potential centralization of resources that have historically been managed by the Kurdish authorities.
key_facts: Thousands protested in Irbil, Iraqi Kurdistan.
The protests were against Baghdad's plans to control oil and border crossings.

related_stories.title: Federal Judge Halts FCC's Early Review of ABC Broadcast Licenses
related_stories.summary: A federal judge has issued a temporary restraining order preventing the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) from conducting an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses. The judge's decision supports ABC's claim that the Trump administration's actions were intended to suppress the network's free speech rights. The ruling highlights concerns over the administration's public criticisms of the network.

related_stories.title: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran Guitarist, Passes Away at 65
related_stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the iconic 1980s new wave band Duran Duran, has died at the age of 65 after a battle with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer. His family and the band confirmed his passing, highlighting his contributions to the band's success with hits like 'Hungry Like the Wolf' and 'Rio.'
